bigquery_syntax: COUNT(DISTINCT col) OVER (PARTITION BY p1, p2, ...)
databricks_sql_syntax:
-- Rewrite using pre-aggregation CTE and join
lookup AS (
  SELECT
    p1,
    p2,
    p3,
    COUNT(DISTINCT col) AS metric
  FROM table
  GROUP BY p1, p2, p3
)
SELECT
  t.*,
  l.metric
FROM table t
JOIN lookup l
  ON t.p1 = l.p1
  AND t.p2 = l.p2
  AND t.p3 = l.p3
example_bq: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT col) OVER (PARTITION BY p1, p2, p3) AS metric FROM table
example_dbsql: WITH lookup AS (\n  SELECT p1,p2,p3, COUNT(DISTINCT col) AS metric FROM table GROUP BY p1,p2,p3\n) SELECT t.*, l.metric FROM table t JOIN lookup l ON t.p1=l.p1 AND t.p2=l.p2 AND t.p3=l.p3
